items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not speak in the provided context; the mention of 'Red' is made by the Interviewer in a discussion about Red Nichols and Red Allen, with no personal connection to Vic Dickenson established.

ctx.x: They played similar, but not the same. But they played much similar to each other. I don't think Red Nichols copied Bix. I think it just was a similarity in their playing. Like, there was a similarity in Red Allen and Louis; there was a similarity in their playing. But I don't think one was...one could have had an influence on the other. But the only one that would have it would be Armstrong would have had an influence on Red...
On Red. Sure. Well, Red was seven years younger.
